arte.universo: Manchester, England, in 1909-1911: a dark university physics laboratory in a Victorian red-brick building, wooden benches, brass and glass apparatus, small sealed brass chambers, a very thin sheet of gold foil, old brass microscopes, gas lamps, rain on tall windows; plus a modern Mexican teenager's bedroom and an empty football stadium at night today. No portraits and no recognizable real people: the scientists are never shown, only their objects and places. Anonymous people only from behind or far away. No readable writing, letters or digits anywhere.

escena.accion: In a dark modern Mexican teenager's bedroom at night, the Pasita rests one hand flat on a wooden desk; around her hand the surface of the desk is shown dissolving into a vast dark space with a few tiny, sparse lime-green glowing dots far apart from each other
escena.protagonista: The Pasita, lower-middle, three-quarter view from behind, small school backpack, looking down at her own hand on the desk
escena.objeto: The wooden desk surface that turns into an almost empty dark space with tiny scattered lime-green points of light
escena.foreground: A closed notebook and a pencil on the desk, slightly blurred (no writing)
escena.midground: The Pasita and her hand on the desk
escena.background: Dark bedroom wall, a window with distant city lights
escena.iluminacion: Very dark room, cold blue light from the window, soft lime glow from the tiny dots
escena.composicion: Medium-wide shot; the upper 42% is the dark, quiet wall and ceiling for the title

cuerpo: Disparó partículas a una hoja de **oro finísima**.

escena.accion: In a dark 1909 university laboratory, on a wooden bench, a small brass apparatus aims at a very thin, shiny sheet of gold foil held in a frame; the Pasita watches it closely
escena.protagonista: The Pasita, lower-right, three-quarter view from behind, small school backpack, leaning toward the gold foil
escena.objeto: A tiny, almost transparent sheet of gold foil glinting in a brass frame, with a small brass source pointed at it
escena.foreground: Glass tubes and a brass instrument on the bench, slightly blurred
escena.midground: The Pasita and the gold foil
escena.background: Dark Victorian laboratory with tall windows and rain, a distant gas lamp
escena.iluminacion: A single warm gas lamp, golden reflections on the foil, deep shadows
escena.composicion: Medium shot; the upper 42% is the dark laboratory ceiling for the title

escena.accion: In a pitch-dark laboratory room, the Pasita looks through an old brass microscope pointed at a small round glass screen where tiny pinpoint flashes of green light appear
escena.protagonista: The Pasita, lower-left, side view, small school backpack, one eye at the microscope, very focused
escena.objeto: An old brass microscope and a small round screen with a few tiny green flashes
escena.foreground: The edge of the wooden bench, slightly blurred

cuerpo: Como si la hoja **no estuviera ahí**.
«Como disparar a un papel y que **la bala regrese**».

escena.accion: In the dark 1909 laboratory, a single bright lime-green spark bounces straight back off the thin gold foil toward the viewer, while many faint sparks pass straight through it; the Pasita jumps back, startled
escena.protagonista: The Pasita, lower-left, three-quarter view, small school backpack, leaning back with surprised wide eyes
escena.objeto: The thin gold foil in its brass frame, faint lines of sparks passing through and one bright lime spark bouncing back
escena.midground: The gold foil and the bouncing spark
escena.background: Dark laboratory, rain on a tall window
escena.iluminacion: Darkness, golden glint of the foil, bright lime spark
escena.composicion: Medium shot; the upper 42% is dark and calm

cuerpo: Toda la masa estaba en **un núcleo diminuto**.

escena.protagonista: The Pasita, lower-middle, seen from behind, small school backpack, small in front of the giant model

cuerpo: el núcleo sería **un granito de arroz**.

escena.protagonista: The Pasita, lower-middle, small in the huge stadium, small school backpack, looking down at her palm
escena.objeto: A tiny glowing lime grain in her palm, the only bright point in the stadium
escena.foreground: Grass of the field, slightly blurred
escena.midground: The Pasita on the center spot

post:
Todo lo que tocas está casi vacío. ⚛️

En 1909, en Mánchester, Ernest Marsden, un estudiante de 20 años, y Hans Geiger dispararon partículas contra una hoja de oro finísima. Casi todas pasaban derecho, como si la hoja no estuviera ahí… pero 1 de cada 8,000 rebotaba.

Su profesor, Ernest Rutherford, dijo que era como disparar una bala contra un papel y que regresara a pegarte. En 1911 explicó por qué: casi toda la masa del átomo está en un núcleo diminuto, y lo demás es casi puro espacio vacío.

Si un átomo fuera un estadio, el núcleo sería un granito de arroz en el centro. ¿Qué te sorprendió más? 👇
